item.title: 4 real? Tracking exploitation and patching of eMudhra’s weak keys
item.description: Four, just four: that’s the key to break into any unpatched connection on the Internet that is using eMudhra certificates. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: Cloudflare services for private origins is now generally available
item.description: Public traffic to private origins, with WAF, bot management, caching, and Workers, is now available to every customer with Cloudflare One connectivity. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: Stripe on Stripe: What we learned moving $1B in vendor payments to Global Payouts
item.description: In early 2026, we began moving our vendor payments to Global Payouts, Stripe’s product for paying recipients in 160+ countries. New-market setup fell from six weeks to one, with a 99.9% payout success rate. Here’s what we learned. (1 source: stripe)
